sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000135-P1, was presented by PFIZER (the Supplier) to Redwood Care Partners 135 on December 6, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 2.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Pneumococcal share floor of 60%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: countered by the Customer.
